parent.science: WSP73 frozen scientific negative (390/768 correct at 397/768 coverage, matched-score 388 correct, 270/420 retention, 18 quartic confident wrong). Focused and G29 both OS PASS; inherited full still running.

hypothesis: Source-blind neural model disagreement can direct PAID physical actions to informative contradictions, after which bounded gradient-free numerical coordinate edits of EXISTING hidden ReLU input weights produce genuine unseen physical prediction/retention gains beyond matched-evidence random edits and readout-only refits, and beyond equally paid random-action intervention policy.

source.cohort: SELFTEST only; no DEV/PRIMARY first use
source.families: four XOR4, four majority-of-3, four coupled AND/XOR with two sensor effects, four nested logical negative challenge sources; new role/channel shuffles and SHA salt; still four-bit synthetic Boolean physics
source.physical: For every seed TWO independent initially identical source-world simulations, active and random B policy, each no-reset 144 paid action session: SAME 96-action A prefix in each copy then 48 paid B actions chosen by its policy. Both copies physically charge their A prefixes (2×144 actions/world = 4608 total); no free reset or teleport. All same-ledger ablations reuse their arm's charged rows, no extra physical actions.
source.heldout: After source-blind learner weights frozen, 12*64=768 primary evaluator-only physical outcomes, 4*64=256 negative, 16*32 independent two-action compositions, split true never-physically-charged contexts per arm.

initial_model: Each copy trains an unmodified WSP70 residual-selected and random-selected numerical ReLU learner on the 96 same-prefix public A observations, with its existing real hidden-neuron growth at 48/96. Freeze source-blind neural matrices before B. Stage-A teacher knowledge score is evaluator-only and never part of policy.

B_policy.active: At each of 48 B steps choose among all four public action channels maximizing the Hamming distance of the two frozen Stage-A neural teachers' FORCED four-bit next-state predictions at the CURRENT REAL visible state. Ties broken by a precommitted seed/step/action SHA256; no hidden source roles, free actions or test truth.
B_policy.control: Independent SHA-seeded uniform random physical action selector. Same 48 real actions, distinct resulting trajectory and information; not equal-information comparison.

repair.capacity: Exactly same hidden ReLU width (32 fixed plus up to 24 grown Stage-A features); may rewrite at most four individual SENSOR input-weight coefficients in its grown ReLU neurons by exactly +0.5 or -0.5 per edit. Never add neurons or change action inputs/bias/source rules.
repair.candidate: Gradient-free discrete finite-difference search on ONLY the charged 96 A +48 B public action/consequence rows: rank grown neurons by summed B |activation|*4-bit squared prediction error using original frozen numeric readout; restrict to top eight with canonical ties. For each of 4 iterations search all unused [top8 neuron, 4 sensor coordinate, delta +/-0.5] changes, score total four-output squared error over the 96 A+48 B charged examples with B residual weighted twice, using frozen Stage-A output weights (no gradient). Accept best mutation iff loss improves by >1e-9; never edit the same coordinate twice. After edits, reset numerical readout and inverse ridge covariance then replay all 144 legitimate charged public rows via rank-one recursive ridge, lambda 0.5.
controls: SAME active A+B ledger: no hidden edits, full numerical readout refit
SAME active A+B ledger: four SHA-seeded random +/-0.5 sensor-coordinate edits in grown neurons, otherwise same readout reset/replay
Equal 96+48 paid actions under random B policy, same direct coordinate-repair algorithm and identical priors; compare intervention selection independently of source information acquired
Exact same active- and random-ledger state/action memory lookup and independent fitted decision tree; report wrong and unseen

Independent fully trained 8->32 ReLU->4 sigmoid neural MLP on exact active A+B 144 real rows, 3 independent Adam starts max 6000 updates each, >=95% charged-training exact needed to call converged; report forced/confident accuracy, training cost and convergence, no unqualified neural superiority claims
Erased numeric readout and cold snapshot tamper negatives
repair.confidence: Unchanged WSP70 min 0.27 bit margin and inverse posterior leverage<=2 for every gradient-free arm. Conventional independent MLP uses >=0.9 each-bit confidence.
repair.retention: Previously true/confident Stage-A original teacher predictions must remain true/confident after B and numerical repair. Truth evaluator-only after all learning.

primary.classification: SELFTEST_SIGNAL only if ALL frozen gates PASS; else SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE

secondary: World source and evaluator task SHA256, both real no-reset 144-action public A+B charged ledgers and unique observed context counts; numerically edited hidden/readout coefficient SHA256 and cold-only model receipts.
All model correct/wrong/abstention, truly unseen physical consequences, two-action task accuracy, retention and CPU. Separate action policy benefit vs same-ledger structural repair benefit.
Conventional gradient-trained 3-start MLP must meet 95% training convergence, otherwise label INCOMPLETE, not beaten. All physical actions and total compute counted.
Four challenge worlds remain negative controls even if repaired network wins primary family. No cherry-pick.
limitations: Four-bit deterministic synthetic worlds and preprogrammed source families remain strong priors; does not prove AGI or general language learning.
Discrete finite-difference coordinate testing is actual supervised optimization on paid physical observations; it is gradient-free direct parameter editing, not spontaneous knowledge creation.
Active/random B streams have equal action counts, not matched information. No OOD guarantee.
Learner can correct numerical weights but still retains WSP70 source-aligned initial 2/3-signed conjunction grammar.
stop: Freeze prereg BEFORE experimental source/learner/tests/results and preserve WSP73 frozen negative.
No post-result mechanism/threshold/source-seed tuning; exact-source mechanical bugfix requires requalification.
Full candidate focused Ubuntu+Windows, generated-only G29 exact source, inherited full dual OS regression before engineering closure.
Remain draft/unmerged with no new owner/controller or official autonomy research-loop scope.
